analysis: The PR change in docs/architecture/inference.md is documentation only: head lines 1584-1592 add a paragraph about tokenizer decoding. An absent clean_up_tokenization_spaces key in the tokenizer config now resolves to false in memory (LocalTokenizerLoader), matching Python Transformers, and an explicit Boolean is kept. The supplied units are base text at lines 1645-2464, which sit outside the changed hunk. Their content (scheduler config, deadlines, MTP, sampling, reasoning parsing, tool-call parsers) is unchanged context. I found no change to controls related to threat-model assets or boundaries (A-001, TB-002, TB-007, T-041). The doc states that input IDs, sampling and cache keys do not depend on the setting, so prefix-cache identity, HMAC lookup tags and cacheSalt scoping (T-041) are not affected on the stated basis. The decode change touches only output text spacing and streamed-decode repetition, so it does not alter encryption, attestation or authorization. Open question for the integration pass: the LocalTokenizerLoader.swift implementation is not supplied, so the claim that cache keys and input IDs are unaffected is unverified. It should hold because encoding is not described as changed, but a code reviewer should confirm that the in-memory resolution does not feed tokenizer identity or fingerprint hashing used in cache or prompt-contract identity. No regression is established from the supplied evidence.
